firewall-disabled.title: The application firewall reports disabled
firewall-disabled.action: Review required sharing and application exceptions, then enable the firewall. Verify required workflows still work. A wildcard listener is not proof of internet reachability.

potential-secret.title: A file contains a possible credential
potential-secret.action: Inspect locally without copying the value into chat. If real, move it to a private credential store. If previously exposed, revoke and rotate it; deleting a file or commit does not revoke a key.

package-advisory.title: A resolved package version matches an advisory
package-advisory.action: Read the maintainer advisory, establish whether the affected feature is deployed or reachable, prepare a compatible update, test, and verify the deployed version. Do not use a blind forced upgrade.

newer-release.title: A newer release is available
newer-release.action: Review vendor release notes and update using the vendor or trusted package manager. Restart consumers and verify the running version. A newer release alone does not prove a particular CVE applies.

eol-runtime.title: A runtime branch is past upstream support
eol-runtime.action: Identify consumers of this exact executable, select a supported release, test compatibility and restart consumers. Do not delete a second installation until its consumers are established.
